title: Collapse compatibility for the canonical recursively generated pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F,G$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and $T$ the explicit product-of-stalk-skyscrapers construction [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model], with multiplication $\mu$ and collapse maps $m_{n,i}$ [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. Suppose $\beta_{H,K}:TH\otimes TK\to T(H\otimes K)$ is natural in both module sheaves, satisfies $(\eta_H\otimes\eta_K)\beta_{H,K}=\eta_{H\otimes K}$, and satisfies $(\mu_H\otimes\mu_K)\beta_{H,K}=\beta_{TH,TK}T(\beta_{H,K})\mu_{H\otimes K}$. If $p_n:T^nF\otimes T^nG\to T^n(F\otimes G)$ satisfies $p_0=\mathrm{id}$ and $p_{n+1}=\beta_{T^nF,T^nG}T(p_n)$, then $(m_{n,i}^F\otimes m_{n,i}^G)p_{n+1}=p_{n+2}m_{n,i}^{F\otimes G}$ for every $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n$. Composition is written from left to right.

proof.text: Induct on n. At n=0 substitute the recursion twice; beta.multiply and multiplication naturality give the asserted equality after map composition is expanded. The hypothesis p0=id is not needed for collapse compatibility and is retained unchanged in the statement. For n+1 split the insertion position into zero and successor. Position zero uses beta.multiply on T^(n+1)F and T^(n+1)G followed by T(p_(n+1)); move this latter map across multiplication by multiplication naturality. At a successor position write each collapse as T of the lower collapse. Substitute the recursion for both pairing terms, move the two T(collapse) maps through beta using beta.naturality, and apply T to the induction hypothesis. Functoriality and associativity identify the resulting composites. Naturality of T and of multiplication follows directly from their product projection formulas and naturality of stalk evaluation. The argument uses beta naturality and multiplication compatibility; coface compatibility alone is insufficient. The cases of an empty scheme and zero sheaves are covered by product uniqueness.

theorem moduleCup_godement_iterate_pairings_collapse_of_canonical
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F G : X.Modules) (β : ModuleCupGodementBeta X)
    (p : ∀ n : ℕ, moduleCup_godementIterate X F n ⊗
      moduleCup_godementIterate X G n ⟶ moduleCup_godementIterate X (F ⊗ G) n)
    (hp0 : p 0 = 𝟙 (F ⊗ G))
    (hprec : ∀ n, p (n + 1) = β.map (moduleCup_godementIterate X F n)
      (moduleCup_godementIterate X G n) ≫ moduleCup_godementMap X (p n)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
      (moduleCup_godementCollapse X F n i ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementCollapse X G n i) ≫
        p (n + 1) = p (n + 2) ≫ moduleCup_godementCollapse X (F ⊗ G) n i
